description:
Stabilize your stablecoins — intelligently.

StableGuard is an AgentverseAI-powered network of autonomous agents that monitors the real-time health of stablecoins like USDC, USDT, and DAI — across exchanges, liquidity venues, and news sources — to detect stress before a depeg happens.

When stablecoins lose their peg, it isn’t sudden — the signals appear early: liquidity dries up, sentiment turns sour, and price correlations break. StableGuard listens to all of them at once.

Instead of reacting after disaster, users get early warnings and AI-generated rebalance plans through Telegram, powered by four specialized agents:
	•	Peg Stability Agent – tracks depegs across venues like Coinbase and Binance.
	•	Liquidity Agent – monitors market depth and routing confidence.
	•	Sentiment Agent – scans crypto headlines and gauges tone shifts.
	•	Reasoner Agent – connects the dots, assigning system regimes: GREEN, YELLOW, or RED.

Finally, the Stablecoin Health (Responder) Agent combines everything into an actionable summary — so users stay informed, in control, and never caught off-guard.

StableGuard doesn’t auto-trade; it empowers.
A stability intelligence network — not a bot farm.
how_its_made:
StableGuard is built as a multi-agent AI system using uAgents and the ASI-1 reasoning API, blending structured data with natural-language intelligence.

Core Architecture:
	•	Each agent runs independently and communicates via uAgents’ decentralized mailbox protocol.
	•	Data flows from:
	•	Peg Agent → CoinGecko APIs for price deviations.
	•	Liquidity Agent → 1inch + Coinbase/Kraken APIs for execution quality.
	•	Sentiment Agent → RSS-based NLP parsing with negation-aware scoring.
	•	The Reasoner Agent merges all signals using ASI1-mini to reason and explain risk levels.
	•	The Responder Agent compiles insights into a human-readable Rebalance Plan, pushing alerts via Telegram.

Tech Stack:
Python, uAgents, ASI-1 API, CoinGecko, 1inch API, RSS feeds, requests, pydantic.

AI Layer:
The ASI reasoning models convert JSON data into plain-English rationales — “Liquidity thinning and negative sentiment detected, recommend partial rotation into USDC.”

UX Layer:
Telegram-based “Vacation Mode” keeps users informed without requiring interaction — privacy-preserving and keyless.

Together, these agents form the first self-aware stability mesh for crypto — a distributed nervous system that keeps stablecoins honest.
